about: The A+ lab's parts (static/lab/machine.js; lab_checks.py reads it too, so the server's compatibility rules are the browser's). Generic names, no brands: the specs are what the exam asks about. Each part's specs are the real part's in its photo (`photo`, static/lab/img/, credited in img/credits.json) - a student can read the label on the picture, so the card must not contradict it.
